_comment: Narration v3 (ElevenLabs Sarah). Same scheme as v2: at = absolute start frame of the file (speech ~1 frame later), anchored (word onset measured in each file: speech-burst start after a pause, ASR timestamp for continuous phrases) so key words land on their picture beats. duck = depth of the music duck under that phrase (0..1), set from the measured bed level so voice sits ~9 dB over the music (v3: the brighter ElevenLabs voice cuts through at a lower ratio) (signature ~8 dB, the bell must still ring). gain = optional per-phrase voice trim.
